SUMMARY

The City engaged the services of the Mathis Group which provided management
training and guidance to the City Council and staff. The training consisted of a variety of
organizational issues including team building, establishing common  goals/values,
council interaction and communication mth eleded officials and staff, keeping informed
on issues, and Commission/ Committee relationships. The training was conducted in
order to create the best possible council norms and practices and to identify behaviors
and values that are conductive to good government.  The training sessions  also
stressed the need to establish mmmon guidelines and norms that will provide a
framework to conduct effective meetings and continue to move the City forward in a
positive manner, These guidelines or "Norms and Procedures" evolved out of the
discussions  during the team building sessions.

The Mathis Group along with city staff reviewed the draft Council Norms and
Procedures whid* are provided for your review and consideration. Staff recommends
adoption of the attached. Document entitled 'Counci) Norms and Procedures.'

RECOMMENDATION

The City Council'waive further reading and adopts Resolution  040-2009  regarding  the
Council  Norms ond Procedures.
